page.overview:
Who is Vitor Azat?

Vitor Azat was imprisoned in Harko Village when the cell he was placed in was visited by Sub-Prefect Tors, who ordered Azat, Arsen Demo and another prisoner to leave while the fourth prisoner remained behind.
